wiki.title: Greg Taylor (politician)
wiki.extract: Greg Taylor (born 1969/1970) is a Democratic member of the Indiana Senate. He has represented the 33rd District since 2008. In November 2020, he was elected as the Minority Floor Leader of the Senate. He is a senior counsel at MWH Law Group, specializing in municipal finance law.
